title: should clamp the custom value to a minimum of 1 and truncate decimals
verifies: the custom relative value floors to 1 for sub-1/negative input and truncates (not rounds) decimals

title: should cap the custom value at the per-unit ten-year maximum
verifies: an oversized value is capped at the per-unit ~10-year maximum (120 months / 5,256,000 minutes)

title: should restore the last valid custom value when the field is emptied on blur
verifies: an emptied/non-numeric value is never applied and the last valid value is restored on blur

title: should re-cap the custom value when the unit changes
verifies: switching units re-clamps the value against the new unit's maximum without re-typing

title: should clamp the custom value and narrow the unit list under a max query range restriction
verifies: max_query_range clamps the value, drops days/weeks/months from the unit list, and disables out-of-range presets

title: should display weeks as weeks in the trigger label
verifies: the trigger label reads the week count rather than the internal day arithmetic
